action.sql: SELECT 'complaint' k, date_trunc('month', date) m, count(*) n FROM complaint GROUP BY 1,2 UNION ALL SELECT 'refund', date_trunc('month', date), count(*) FROM refund GROUP BY 1,2 UNION ALL SELECT 'complaint_'||reason, date_trunc('month', date), count(*) FROM complaint GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2
